statement: The points are $A(1,0,0)$, $B(0,1,0)$ and $C(0,0,1)$. Find the area of triangle $ABC$ and the angle $\angle BAC$.
solution: $\vec{AB}=(-1,1,0)$, $\vec{AC}=(-1,0,1)$. Cross product $\vec{AB}\times\vec{AC}=(1,1,1)$, magnitude $\sqrt{3}$. Area $=\tfrac12|\vec{AB}\times\vec{AC}|=\tfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$. $\cos\angle BAC=\dfrac{\vec{AB}\cdot\vec{AC}}{|\vec{AB}||\vec{AC}|}=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}\sqrt{2}}=\tfrac12$, so $\angle BAC=60^{\circ}$.
hints: Use the cross product to get the area.
Use the dot product to find the angle at $A$.
